scripts.build: npm run check:structure && npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @money-graph/api && npm run build --workspace @money-graph/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs && npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @money-graph/api
scripts.typecheck:acceptance: tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --strict --esModuleInterop --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 scripts/acceptance/browser.spec.ts scripts/acceptance/playwright.config.ts
